subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about driving qualified property leads for your listing portal in the South African market. The one point worth repeating: we optimize to the qualified enquiry, the moment a real user submits contact intent on a live listing, read back through a portal-side postback and held until it clears de-duplication and a contactability check. So you pay for screened enquiries, with duplicate, bot, and aged traffic filtered out first, at an effective cost per qualified lead near R85 (illustrative). Worth a short look at the province-level read?
angle: warm bump, restate qualified-property-lead validation proof
illustrative_flags: effective cost per qualified lead near R85 (MobUpps, illustrative)
register_notes: Stage 1 EN real_estate_proptech: references prior outreach in first sentence; restates single proof (qualified-lead optimization + de-duplication/contactability validation); one illustrative figure (R85 cost per qualified lead); soft CTA, 1 question mark; native SA business English, no transliteration; no sign-off; X-not-Y avoided (stated positively).
